text:
Lia Chen: Quick PSA — my Go sample app using the generator stream keeps hanging when attempting to resume after an auth refresh.
Sam Ortiz: repro steps?
Lia Chen: Steps:
1) Start generator.Stream with ctx
2) Long-running stream, then token expires, auth middleware triggers refresh
3) We cancel ctx to reconnect, then call Stream again -> sometimes the new stream never yields tokens

Lia Chen: Minimal snippet:
```
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
gen := client.Generator("gpt-open-...")
stream, err := gen.Stream(ctx, req)
// read tokens in goroutine
// token refresh occurs concurrently
cancel()
newStream, err := gen.Stream(context.Background(), req)
```
Sam Ortiz: Do you see goroutines stuck in Read or in our transport's dial?
Lia Chen: pprof shows goroutine blocked on transport.recvLoop -> waiting on read from tcp conn. The old connection wasn't fully closed during auth refresh.
Natalie Gomez: Could be our http.Transport's idle conn reuse + context cancel not closing body. We saw similar with long polling.
Kevin Park: This smells like race between auth round-trip that swaps in new credentials and the generator's handshake which reuses existing connection. We should atomic-swap credentials before dialing new stream.
Sam Ortiz: Also the Go generator Stream API returns a channel of tokens; it's hard to signal 'resume' semantics. Maybe expose explicit StreamSession that supports Close() / ReplaceWith(newCtx) so callers can handle reconnects.
Lia Chen: Yea, ergonomically the pattern we want is:
```
sess := gen.NewSession(ctx, opts)
for tok := range sess.Tokens() { ... }
// sess.ResumeWith(ctx2)
```
Sam Ortiz: Agree. For short-term fix we can force transport.CloseIdleConnections() after cancel, and ensure we call resp.Body.Close() even on errors.
Kevin Park: I'll open an issue and add a tiny repro in go-gen-sample. Linking: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-gen-sample/issues/42
ci-bot: build passed for the sample on main after adding resp.Body.Close() :white_check_mark:
Natalie Gomez: Sounds good. Lia, can you drop the sample repro in the issue and assign to @kevin? :+1:
Lia Chen: Done — uploaded repro gist and logs. Assign to Kevin.
Kevin Park: I'll pick this up this sprint. Plan: 1) hotfix transport closes, 2) add session API RFC, 3) integration test that simulates token swap.
Lia Chen: Thanks all — leaving the thread here, will follow up in GH.
